name: AN/TPS-80 G/ATOR multi-mission radar
description: S-band GaN AESA expeditionary multi-mission radar, 360 deg. USMC air surveillance and air defense (Block 1) plus counterfire (Block 2); the sensor for MRIC. No public small-UAS range; ring is a role planning factor.

detectRangeM.note: Outside the sensor/radar/any/any prior by 3.5 spreads; kept as a planning figure

rangeAccuracyM.note: Planning factor: 30 m for a pulse-compressed medium-range surveillance waveform; no early-warning radar in the library publishes a figure and the nearest sourced value is the RPS-42 brochure 50 m.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: about a tenth of a 2 to 3° S- or L-band beam (beam splitting or monopulse at 10 dB SNR, Skolnik), so 0.3°; no early-warning radar in the library publishes a figure.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: 0.5° for a stacked-beam or e-scan elevation estimate on a 2 to 3° beam; no early-warning radar in the library publishes a figure.

falseAlarmRatePerScan.note: Planning factor: PLACARD_PFA 1e-6 (src/model/types.ts) times about 1e6 range-azimuth-Doppler cells per scan of a 360° surveillance volume gives about one false alarm per scan over the whole coverage; this 360° radar is recorded at 1. No vendor publishes a false-alarm rate.
